segments.he:
תּוֹרָה קצד
מִי שֶׁרוֹצֶה כָּבוֹד הוּא שׁוֹטֶה, עַיֵּן פְּנִים:
segments.en: As soon as a person wishes to enter the service of Hashem, may He be blessed — it is then immediately a great sin if one has sadness — G-d forbid. For sadness is the sitra achra and the Holy One, blessed be He, hates it. (See above §24 — it is a great commandment to always be in joy. For just as sadness is a great sin — so in the opposite direction — joy is a great commandment. Fortunate is one who merits to always be in joy. For it is a healing for the person in physicality and spirituality.)
